content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric utility generating and distributing power to households and businesses, though it adds telecom services the target lacks."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric and natural gas utility serving residential and commercial customers over owned networks, closely matching the target's utility model."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric and gas delivery utility earning rate-based returns on its own networks, matching the target's core utility business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Propane distributor selling bottled and bulk fuel with appliance services; lacks the target's regulated gas and electric utility networks."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas utility delivering to homes and businesses, similar to the target's gas distribution, though with added clean energy ventures."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution network serving residential and commercial customers, matching the gas utility part of the target's business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner making and selling gasoline and jet fuel with retail stations; a different business from regulated utility distribution."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Regulated gas utility plus propane distribution to homes and businesses, closely mirroring the target's mix of utility and propane operations."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Propane and heating oil delivery business with no regulated utility networks; overlaps only in propane sold to similar households."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Regulated electric and natural gas utility serving residential and commercial customers under state commission rates, matching the target's utility model."}]}
